info.title: Student Assignment Tracker API
info.description: Versioned REST API. Authentication uses HttpOnly cookies (short-lived access token + rotating refresh token). All state-changing requests require the `x-csrf-token` header (obtain via GET /api/v1/auth/csrf or GET /api/v1/me). Errors use the `Error` envelope. Lists use `page`/`pageSize` pagination and return `{ items, page, pageSize, total, totalPages }`.
